content: You cannot do a kindness too soon, for you never know how soon it will be too late.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Time is fleeting and human lives are fragile. Postponing acts of generosity and words of love is the most common and painful regret.
practicalInsight: Express your appreciation or offer practical help to someone you care about right now.
reflectionPrompt: Whom have you meant to encourage or thank, and why wait another day?
